task.title: To delete a style for a segment in a template

step.cmd: Go to the Work tab > Set Segment tab in X-Author Templates.
Select the segment from the segment list. The selected segment is highlighted in the template.
Click the gear icon () next to Segment Regular to open the Segment Regular page.
Click Delete. You will see a confirmation message. Click Delete again.

postreq.p: Your segment is successfully deleted and the content control boundary of your segment is removed.
